purpose: create a repository that is ready for a team to work in safely from the first commit
entry_criteria: A project is approved and named
A version control platform is available
Team members and owners are known
procedure: Create the repository with a clear name and description under the right organization.
Add the basic files: README with build and run steps, licence, contributing guide, code owners and an ignore file.
Protect the main branch: require review and passing checks, and block force pushes.
Set up CI to run build and tests on every pull request from the first commit.
Turn on secret scanning and dependency alerts, and do not commit credentials or generated files.
Grant access by team with least privilege and record who owns the repository.
acceptance_criteria: The README lets a newcomer build and run the project

validation.command: git clone <repo-url> /tmp/fresh && cd /tmp/fresh && ls README.md LICENSE CODEOWNERS   # example

failure_modes.response: Revoke, rotate and clean history per policy
Fix and test the steps on a clean machine

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A new service repository is created with README, licence and code owners; the main branch requires one review and a passing CI run, and a fresh clone builds with the documented commands.
